government.note: De facto state in the north of Cyprus, recognised only by Turkey; the Republic of Cyprus claims the area. Its institutions are recorded factually: a directly elected President (two-round system, five-year term), described by the source as a non-ceremonial office in a semi-presidential system, and a Prime Minister heading the government, which rests on a majority in the 50-member Assembly of the Republic.

system.note: 50 members elected by party-list PR in multi-member district constituencies; voters can cast votes for several candidates, so the vote totals in the sources exceed the number of voters. The threshold and formula were not checked. seats_2000 is the result of the December 1998 election.

start_2000.ideology_support_note: Derived from the December 1998 Assembly vote (shares computed from the vote counts): National Unity Party 40.39% and Democratic Party 22.60% (recorded as national conservative, a gameplay classification), Communal Liberation Party 15.32% and Republican Turkish Party 13.37% (centre-left, recorded as social democrat), other lists 8.32% (big_tent).
